spec.claim_summary: A Bitcoin system buys when two trend scores exceed 7 with price at a 10-day high and exits when a trend score falls below 5.
spec.untestable_reason: No mechanical rule can be recovered because entry and exit depend on proprietary Bitcoin Trend Score values not available in the schema.

claimed.other: achieving an average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%

assumptions: Asset interpreted as BTCUSDT from claim reference to Bitcoin.
Timeframe 1d taken from page chart; claim implies daily bars via '10-day high' but does not state timeframe.
Direction interpreted as long from reference to buy signals.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Bitcoin Trend Score and Bitcoin Relative Trend Score entry levels above 7 and exit below 5 are proprietary scores with no equivalent indicator in the schema.
No testable entry-exit core retained because the proprietary scores are the heart of the system; the 10-day high alone is not the claimed system.

evidence.quote: achieving an average gain of 1436.28% per win, while losses averaged -18.78%
